notes.title: Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree - Version 1.0.7 is now LIVE!🔴
notes.content:
[h2]✨ [b]Hey everyone![/b] ✨[/h2][p]
We've listened to your feedback and we have a new update for Bahamut and The Waqwaq Tree, and the best part is, it's live now! You can read the full patch notes below 👇[/p][h2]
[b]Patch Notes For Version 1.0.7:[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Improved drawing shape recognition to make it easier for users to draw circles[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the timer from NPC dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the volume for some NPC sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the timer for certain gates to make it easier for users to pass through[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual feedback in case the user accidentally intersects the line while solving the Linking Dots puzzle[/p][/*][*][p]Added a checkpoint in Level 2.1 to prevent a soft lock situation[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the position of certain checkpoints to prevent the user from respawning too far away[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few scripted camera moments to guide the player[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the French subtitle issue during the final cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual tweaks and fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Minor Arabic localization text fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]We hop you enjoy these updates. If you have any other issues, send us your feedback on our Discord.[/p][p]Also, if you haven't yet, please review us on Steam!   [/p][p][/p][p]Happy gaming, and remember to always follow the light. 🐋🕯️[/p][h2]🐋 Stay tuned for more updates![/h2][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FStarvaniaStudio"]Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree on X[/url]
[url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FPmQbHS2fQb"]Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree's Discord[/url]
[url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fstarvaniastudio%2F"]Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree on Instagram[/url][/p]

notes.title: Bahamut And The Waqwaq Tree is Available NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree is available to download and play RIGHT NOW! 🔥🔥🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506877/a200866cde33ea9e1424c1ef52126cac47b13e02.gif[/img]

Play as Nour in a 2D narrative adventure that has you exploring the cosmic sea of Maeen, cleanse the world from darkness and restore balance between the light and the dark. 🌟🌑

Check out the launch trailer below! 🎥

[previewyoutube=5tdp_qlSfiE;full][/previewyoutube]

It's been a long journey to get here, and we're so excited that you can finally get your hands on it! 🎮

Download it now, and make sure to leave us a review on our page, we'd love to hear what you think!

We really hope you enjoy it! 

P.S: As a special treat, you can find our co-founders, Muslih and Meaad will be broadcasting the game on Steam too!

[h2] 🐋 Follow us to always stay up to date![/h2]

notes.content:

notes.title: Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree - 0.3.6.alpha Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed VSync option being reversed (on was off, off was on).
[*]Adjustments to layering to prevent the player for being rendered behind background/midground elements.
[*]Scroll bar adjusted on first scrollable text.
[*]Fixed double input issue on disclaimer dismissal fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Other:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Subtitles in cutscenes typography changed for a more visible font.
[*]Increased lighting on last area after Light Tree activation.
[*]Corrected some typos on the Arabic version of the text.
[/list]

[h2]🐋 Stay tuned for more updates![/h2]

notes.title: Play Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree in Steam Next Fest! | Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone! ✨

We are [b]excited to announce that we will be featured in the upcoming Steam Next Fest[/b]! 🌊 We can’t wait to see your reactions and hear your feedback as you dive into Ma'een with us.

[h3]Experience Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree for the first time in our Steam Next Fest Demo, available on June 10th - 17th![/h3]

[h3]During the Steam Next Fest, you can:
[/h3][list]
[*][b]Play the Demo:[/b] Experience a sneak peek of the game and get a taste of the adventure that awaits.
[*][b]Join Live streams:[/b] Participate in live streams to dive deep into the game’s lore, mechanics, and development process.
[*][b]Join the Discord:[/b] Chat with the developers and community on our Discord channel for ongoing discussions and exclusive insights.
[/list]
[b]More details about the streams and demo coming soon.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506877/a200866cde33ea9e1424c1ef52126cac47b13e02.gif[/img]
[h2]About Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree[/h2]
[b]Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree[/b] is an immersive adventure game inspired by Arabian and Middle Eastern mythology. Get ready to submerge yourself in a captivating underwater realm, explore the cosmic sea of Ma'een, and unlock the secrets of an ancient mystery.
[h3]Key Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Explore the cosmic sea, Ma'een 🌊
[*]Harness the power of the light ✨
[*]Solve the ancient mystery 🔒
[/list]
We hope you're excited for the demo as much as we are. See you at Steam Next Fest! 👋
[h2] 🐋 Stay tuned for more updates![/h2]
